notes: Generated 29 test methods across 4 DDD layers based on confirmed intents. Tests follow NUnit 3.14.0 conventions with Moq 4.20.72 for mocking. Domain layer tests are pure unit tests without mocking. Application layer mocks repository interfaces. Infrastructure layer uses both in-memory EF Core and Moq for DbContext. Presentation layer mocks services and tests handler responses. Production classes referenced in tests do not exist yet - this is expected TDD workflow.
